about: Computed offline on the made-up SharkCam catch table (not field data). Mean test accuracy over 200 random splits, with the standard deviation across splits. Each of the 268 spadenose sharks gets 4 made-up frames: length, girth, depth and temperature re-measured with noise (SD 0.4 cm, 0.25 cm, 0.3 m and 0.05 C; month unchanged). Task: mature or not from length, girth, depth, temperature and month.
